operand_contract: W=P*Sv in FP32. TF32 rounds W to 10 fraction bits RNE; C in [-7,7] is exactly representable. Two-part is hi=RNE10(W), lo=RNE10(W-hi), two FP32 contractions and final sum. This emulates formats, not actual MMA or performance. Compare to both factorized FP32 W*C and FP32 P*BF16(decoded V); retain dequantization-rounding gap.
